resolvedFindings.finding: Mode-inapplicable known JSON fields could silently discard payload.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Per-mode fields and explicit data payload are validated; original numeric-with-bytes reproduction now exits 2.

resolvedFindings.finding: Explicit -text plus positional text silently replaced one payload.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Conflicting text sources reject with exit 2.

resolvedFindings.finding: JSON null byte values silently became NUL bytes.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Null values reject before typed JSON conversion; reproduced original case exits 2. Duplicate keys and unexpected field casing also reject.

resolvedFindings.finding: Top-level JSON null was treated as an empty segment array.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The segment document must be an array; original null-root case exits 2.

resolvedFindings.finding: Recursive token validation permitted excessive nesting before typed decoding rejected it.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Explicit depth bound rejects before deep traversal. A 100,000-level, 200,001-byte reproduction now exits 2 in approximately 2 ms at approximately 10 MB subprocess peak RSS, versus approximately 81 MB before the fix. No fatal-stack-overflow claim is made.

resolvedFindings.finding: Implicit encoding of Japanese consumer source could fail on a non-UTF-8 Windows locale.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Explicit UTF-8 file/subprocess IO and PYTHONUTF8 are present. Linux package checks pass on both toolchains; native Windows validation remains pending.

resolvedFindings.finding: Documentation needed to distinguish unpublished status, flag-parser text errors, and the scope of GS1 validation Context.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Prepublication/native gates, conditional remote installation, flag-parser behavior and Context application are documented.
